question: Archana can eat 21 litchis in 60 minutes. She wants to know how many minutes it would take her to eat 35 litchis at the same pace.
solution:
**Given:**

Archana can eat 21 litchis in 60 minutes.

She wants to know how many minutes it would take her to eat 35 litchis at the same pace.

**Formula used:**

Time taken to eat litchis = (Number of litchis / Number of litchis eaten in given time) × Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken to eat 35 litchis = (35 / 21) × 60

⇒ Time taken = (35 / 21) × 60

⇒ Time taken = 5/3 × 60

⇒ Time taken = 100 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
